is_closing_force_exercise.meaning: the force exercise is a closing event terminating an existing long option position

move_flag.meaning: the _move context flag passed to PanopticMath.calculateIOAmounts (true=open/mint, false=close)

token_delta_correct.meaning: the underlying token delta charged/refunded to the exercisee matches the close-context settlement amount

assumptions: Force exercise is a closing event that terminates the existing long position.
exerciseCost is the entry point that computes token deltas and collateral for the force exercise.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who triggers the force exercise or any authorization condition; not needed for the close-context correspondence.
No concrete numeric expected-versus-actual token amounts are provided; token_delta_correct is a grounded Boolean for the qualitative correctness relation.

limitations: Only the incorrect_token_deltas impact is formalized; pool_imbalance and liquidation_revert are deferred to future claims.
The correspondence is stated qualitatively; concrete token amounts require later code binding.
The report phrases impacts as potential, so the relation is a required correspondence rather than an observed incident.
